renderer_scope: Single part. Metric A-series sheet. Layout presets and drafting guidance only.

gb-machining.label: GB general machined part
review: Confirm the primary view and the dimension datums from the functional faces
Review hole depths, hole-pattern positions, fits and surface requirements

iso-machining.label: ISO GPS general machined part
review: Confirm the projection method and sheet size against the contract
Datums, tolerances and surface texture come from the drawing requirements

iso-sheet-metal.label: Sheet-metal and stamped part
review: Distinguish the formed drawing from a verified flat pattern; record thickness and bend direction
Cite stamping, bending or thermal-cutting standards only where the process and contract apply
Flat-pattern layout and bend allowances must come from approved data

iso-casting.label: Casting blank and machined casting
review: Check wall thickness, cavities and passages in section
Distinguish the casting blank from the machined state; review which surfaces keep machining allowance
ASME Y14.8 belongs to another contract system option

iso-weld-prep.label: Single-part bevel and weld preparation
review: Check the single-part bevel, land and root dimensions on an end view or section
The welding-symbol system is set by the contract; AWS A2.4 can serve as the other system's reference
This template is for single-part preparation drawings

asme-machining.label: Metric review sketch for North American machining projects
review: Check sheet size, units, projection and annotation against the contract
The preset writes metric A-series sheets; use an approved template for ANSI sheets or inches before formal delivery

asme-aerospace.label: Metric review sketch for aerospace or high-traceability single parts
review: Confirm the precedence and revisions of the controlled drawing, data set and customer requirements
Review key characteristics, material lot requirements, special processes and inspection notes
Y14.41 applies to digital product definition processes the contract invokes

asme-additive.label: Metric review sketch for additively manufactured single parts
review: Check internal channels and inspectable regions in section
Distinguish as-printed from post-processed states; give build orientation and surface finish from approved data
